rationale: The story is about a systemic blind spot in logistics operations. An architectural night shot of a massive loading dock captures the physical environment of the handover, while a single empty, illuminated bay visually represents the vanished load that the system missed.

core_thesis: Control towers fail to flag the most costly cargo theft—loads handed to fake carriers at pickup—meaning agent autonomy should be restricted by loss severity, not exception frequency.
core_conflict: High-volume automated exception clearing versus high-severity, untraceable identity fraud at the pickup dock.
